result:
I couldn't recompute the evidence-log hashes and didn't run anything; this rests on reading the source, the fixtures, the recorded logs and the reference Academy routers.

The big blocker: the recorded clippy run (`clippy -D warnings`) failed with exit code 101, from 7 `unwrap()` calls in the unit tests, so the static gate isn't green. On the hosted contract, the doc and fixture expect the exam status `in_progress`, but Academy returns `in-progress`. The Daily Incident's final debrief check passes for any shift, even one that doesn't exist. And the call program still has no way to accept "either correct or incorrect" as an answer outcome, which the hosted Daily Incident needs.
